name: askama-vscode
description: Highlighting, navigation and completion for Askama templates in Rust projects.

askama.server.path.description: Path to the askama-lsp executable. Leave empty to use the one built in this repository (development) or bundled with the extension.

askama.templateGlobs.description: Glob patterns for the files the language server treats as Askama templates.

askama.typeCompletion.description: Complete the members of a template's values (such as `order.customer.`) by asking a private rust-analyzer about their types. It starts on first use and loads the crate, which takes memory and time. Restart the language server after changing this.

askama.rustAnalyzer.path.description: The rust-analyzer executable for type completion. Leave empty to use the one the rust-analyzer extension ships, or else `rust-analyzer` on the PATH. Restart the language server after changing this.

askama.trace.server.description: Traces the messages between VS Code and askama-lsp in the Askama Language Server output channel.

scripts.test: vscode-tmgrammar-test -c -g test/grammar/vendor/html.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammar/vendor/html-derivative.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammar/vendor/source.js.stub.json -g test/grammar/vendor/source.css.stub.json "test/grammar/*.test.html" && node --test out/editing.test.js
